result.description: Customer service platform (people-centered helpdesk) unifying voice, chat, email, SMS and social conversations around customer profiles.
result.auth_detail: Token-based Basic Auth: username = agent email, password = API token, over HTTPS. Tokens tied to one user and environment (sandbox vs production); the user needs the API User role. No OAuth2 for third-party use found.
result.access_detail: Tokens are created inside a Gladly tenant by a user with the API User role. No public signup, free tier or developer sandbox found. Credentials exist only inside a paying customer's (sales-led) account, or through a partner arrangement.
result.api_notes: REST API v1 at https://{organization}.gladly.com/api/v1, with OpenAPI spec. Covers customers, conversations, messages, tasks, topics, agents and users, webhooks, reports, exports and organization. Also Lookup API and Glad Hub.
result.blocker: No self-serve signup or sandbox. API tokens exist only inside an existing customer's Gladly tenant, so we would need a customer account or partner access first.

evidence.quote: Perhaps the most familiar authentication option, basic auth (as it is often called) requires an Agent to provide a username and password for a request.
To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.
API tokens are required to use Gladly APIs for security and authentication purposes.
The integration partner should provide the email address to be used with the integration's user account in Gladly.
